title: Feedback
description: Found a bug, have an idea or a question about Hashi? Tell us.
intro: A bug, an idea, a question, or something about your data? Tell us: we read every message and get back to you as soon as we can.

placeholders.bug: What did you do, what happened, and what did you expect?
placeholders.idea: What would you like, and what for?
placeholders.question: What would you like to know?

name: Name
email_hint: Only if you'd like an answer.

context.title: Sent with your message
context.intro: So we can find a problem faster. Nothing else about you or your device is added.

sent: Your message has arrived. If you left an email address, we'll answer there.
privacy: We only use your message and what's sent with it to answer you and to fix problems, and delete it after six months at the latest. More in the privacy policy.

fixed.subject: what you told us about is done
fixed.fixed: The problem you reported is fixed.
fixed.done: Your idea is now part of Hashi.
fixed.app: It arrives with the next update of the app.
fixed.web: It is live on hashi.rs already.
fixed.thanks: Thank you for helping make Hashi better!
